tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the timeline entries and the full text of every evidence document. Returns matching entries (date, headline, id) and document pages with a snippet. Use plain words: names, companies, amounts, phrases.

tools.name: get_dossier
tools.description: The site's home page: the whole record told in order, with section titles. Pass a section title to get one section.

tools.name: list_entries
tools.description: Every dated timeline entry (id, date, headline), optionally filtered by year or by a word in the headline.

tools.name: get_entry
tools.description: One timeline entry in full: date, headline, the account, its sources (with the evidence documents it cites) and the question it raises.

tools.name: list_profiles
tools.description: The profile pages: PRE Security, its people (John Peterson, Paul Jespersen, Stewart Reichardt, Bob Darabant) and the founders' other companies, with the slug to pass to get_profile.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: A person or company profile: key facts as questions and answers, the findings, and every entry about them.

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: An evidence document's description, the entries that cite it, its public page and its extracted text, page by page. Long documents come in parts: pass start_page to continue.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
